name: Tomato 'Roma'
careInstructions: Water deeply at the base, avoid wetting leaves. Provide support with stakes or cages.

name: Lavender 'Munstead'
careInstructions: Well-draining soil is essential. Prune lightly after flowering to maintain shape.

name: Kale 'Lacinato'
careInstructions: Keep soil consistently moist. Harvest outer leaves first to encourage continued growth.

name: Basil 'Genovese'
careInstructions: Pinch off flower spikes to encourage leaf production. Water when top inch of soil is dry.

name: Zucchini 'Black Beauty'
careInstructions: Needs plenty of space. Watch for powdery mildew. Harvest frequently for best flavor.

name: Mint 'Peppermint'
careInstructions: Invasive; best grown in containers. Keep soil moist and harvest regularly.

name: Carrot 'Nantes'
careInstructions: Requires loose, stone-free soil. Thin seedlings to 3 inches apart for straight roots.

name: Rosemary
careInstructions: Drought-tolerant once established. Avoid overwatering. Prefers sandy soil.

name: Bell Pepper 'California Wonder'
careInstructions: Requires warm soil and consistent moisture. Mulch to retain water and suppress weeds.

name: Thyme 'English'
careInstructions: Low maintenance. Prune back in early spring to prevent woody growth.

name: Lettuce 'Butterhead'
careInstructions: Prefers cooler temperatures. Protect from afternoon sun in hot climates.

name: Oregano 'Greek'
careInstructions: Very hardy. Allow soil to dry between waterings. Flavor is best just before blooming.

name: Spinach 'Bloomsdale'
careInstructions: Bolts quickly in heat. Keep soil moist and mulch to keep roots cool.

name: Coriander (Cilantro)
careInstructions: Grows quickly and bolts in heat. Reseed every 2-3 weeks for a continuous harvest.

name: Cucumber 'Marketmore'
careInstructions: Vining plant; needs trellis or space. Keep soil consistently moist for sweet fruit.

name: Parsley 'Flat Leaf'
careInstructions: Biennial. Keep soil moist. Harvest outer stems first.
